_README: Copy to playwright/.auth/credentials.json (gitignored). Read by tests/helpers/credentials.ts.
Environment variables VANNBROSPHASETWO_<ROLE>_USER / _PASS take precedence and are what CI should use.
Usually produced by `pnpm creds:import`; move an entry out of _unassigned into a role key to enable that role.
Known roles: admin, supervisor, responsible, operator, farmhand, multiGrower, restrictedLocation, bypassAttendance, inactive
